title: RAG Loaders and Chunkers
summary: This module provides a comprehensive set of data loaders for various sources (files, web, databases) and a utility for chunking text, essential for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems.

nodes.label: Base Loader
nodes.title: Abstract Base Loader
nodes.description: Defines the abstract interface for all RAG data loaders, requiring a 'load' method and providing a utility for generating unique document IDs.

nodes.label: Base Chunker
nodes.title: Text Chunking Utility
nodes.description: Splits large text documents into smaller, overlapping chunks using a recursive character text splitter, configurable by chunk size, overlap, and separators.

nodes.label: CSV Loader
nodes.title: Load CSV Data
nodes.description: Loads content from CSV files or URLs, parsing it into a readable text format with extracted headers and row data, and includes metadata about the CSV structure.

nodes.label: Directory Loader
nodes.title: Load Files from Directory
nodes.description: Recursively loads and processes multiple files from a specified directory, supporting filtering by file extensions and combining their content into a single result.

nodes.label: Docs Site Loader
nodes.title: Load Documentation Websites
nodes.description: Extracts structured content from documentation websites by fetching HTML, parsing it with BeautifulSoup, and organizing text, titles, and navigation links.

nodes.label: DOCX Loader
nodes.title: Load DOCX Documents
nodes.description: Loads content from Microsoft Word (.docx) files, either from local paths or URLs, extracting text from paragraphs and handling temporary file downloads.

nodes.label: GitHub Loader
nodes.title: Load GitHub Repository Content
nodes.description: Fetches and processes information from GitHub repositories, including repository metadata, READMEs, file structures, pull requests, and issues, using the GitHub API.

nodes.label: JSON Loader
nodes.title: Load JSON Data
nodes.description: Loads and parses JSON content from files or URLs, converting it into a readable string representation, and includes metadata about the JSON structure.

nodes.label: MDX Loader
nodes.title: Load MDX Files
nodes.description: Loads content from MDX (Markdown with JSX) files or URLs, cleaning it by removing import/export statements and JSX tags to extract pure markdown text.

nodes.label: MySQL Loader
nodes.title: Load MySQL Database Content
nodes.description: Connects to a MySQL database using a provided URI and executes SQL queries to fetch and format data from tables into a readable text output.

nodes.label: PDF Loader
nodes.title: Load PDF Documents
nodes.description: Extracts text content from PDF files, supporting both local files and URLs, and handles temporary file downloads and page-by-page text extraction.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Loader
nodes.title: Load PostgreSQL Database Content
nodes.description: Connects to a PostgreSQL database using a provided URI and executes SQL queries to fetch and format data from tables into a readable text output.

nodes.label: Text File Loader
nodes.title: Load Local Text Files
nodes.description: Loads raw text content directly from a specified local file path, ensuring the file exists and reading its entire content.

nodes.label: Raw Text Loader
nodes.title: Load Raw Text Input
nodes.description: A simple loader that directly uses the provided string content as the document content, without external file or URL fetching.

nodes.label: Web Page Loader
nodes.title: Load Web Page Content
nodes.description: Fetches and parses content from a given URL, extracting visible text from the HTML using BeautifulSoup, and removing scripts and styles.

nodes.label: XML Loader
nodes.title: Load XML Data
nodes.description: Loads and parses XML content from files or URLs, extracting all text content from the XML structure into a single readable string.

nodes.label: YouTube Channel Loader
nodes.title: Load YouTube Channel Info
nodes.description: Extracts metadata and summaries of recent videos from a YouTube channel, optionally fetching transcript previews for each video.

nodes.label: YouTube Video Loader
nodes.title: Load YouTube Video Transcript
nodes.description: Fetches and extracts the transcript of a specific YouTube video, including metadata like title and author, to provide its textual content.

groups.label: Core RAG Components
groups.title: Foundational RAG Building Blocks
groups.description: Abstract base classes for defining data loading and text chunking functionalities within Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) workflows.

groups.label: Document Loaders
groups.title: Loaders for Common Document Formats
groups.description: Specialized loaders for extracting text from various document types like Microsoft Word (.docx), PDF files, and plain text files from local storage.

groups.label: Structured Data Loaders
groups.title: Loaders for Structured Data Formats
groups.description: Loaders designed to parse and extract information from structured data formats such as CSV, JSON, XML, and MDX, converting them into readable text.

groups.label: Web & API Loaders
groups.title: Loaders for Web Content and APIs
groups.description: Components for fetching and processing content from general web pages, structured documentation sites, and GitHub repositories via their respective APIs.

groups.label: Video Content Loaders
groups.title: Loaders for YouTube Video Content
groups.description: Specialized loaders for extracting information and transcripts from YouTube channels and individual videos, providing their textual content for RAG.

groups.label: Database Loaders
groups.title: Loaders for Relational Databases
groups.description: Loaders for connecting to and querying relational databases like MySQL and PostgreSQL to retrieve structured data and format it for RAG processing.
